title: Automated Perifusion System for Modifying Cell Culture Conditions
author: Whitticar, Strahler, et al.
materials: See How to Create Program below.

steps.title: Connect pumps and power
steps.instruction: Plug the USB cable into the computer and attach the network cable adapter labeled “CBL‑PC‑PUMP”. Connect the adapter to the first pump (bottom side labeled “computer”) – this becomes Pump 00. Then connect a second network cable from the “pump network” slot on Pump 00 to the “computer” slot on the next pump – this becomes Pump 01. Plug in the power supplies for both pumps; each pump should emit a beep when power is applied.

steps.title: Prepare syringes
steps.instruction: Label each syringe, fill it to the appropriate level, and eliminate bubbles by tapping the syringe on the bench to loosen bubbles and expelling air from the needle.

steps.title: Mount syringes in apparatus
steps.instruction: Place each syringe in the apparatus with the head of the plunger in the vice and tighten the vice (the screw turns opposite to the standard direction).

steps.title: Secure syringe barrels
steps.instruction: Pull up and spin the tab over the barrel of each syringe to lock it in place.

steps.title: Assemble hose system
steps.instruction: Connect hose tubing to the end of each syringe; the hoses converge at a “Y” junction. Run a single hose from the Y junction through the heating apparatus and into the tube that leads to the well. Assemble the peristaltic pump outflow line and set its flow‑rate to match the rate that will be programmed later.

steps.title: Load fluids into syringe slide
steps.instruction: Squeeze the white tab on the side of the syringe slide and slide it until the second fluid appears at the Y junction. Repeat with the remaining pump, sliding until fluid fills the well enough to form a meniscus visible with the objective lens.

steps.title: Open control software
steps.instruction: Launch “SyringePumpProV1” on the computer and verify that Pump 00 and Pump 01 appear in the pump worksheet; if they do not, re‑check network and power connections and restart the program.

steps.title: Create PPL program
steps.instruction: Click the “PPL” tab, select “PPL Creator”, choose “Standard”, and follow the “How to Create Program” instructions to define the desired perfusion protocol.

steps.title: Upload program to Pump 00
steps.instruction: After saving the protocol for Pump 00, right‑click Pump 00, choose “Upload PPL file”, and allow the program to run until a beep sounds. Click “OK” on any popup that appears, then right‑click Pump 00 again and select “Refresh values”.

steps.title: Upload program to Pump 01
steps.instruction: Repeat the upload steps used for Pump 00 for Pump 01 (create its protocol, right‑click, upload PPL file, wait for beep, click OK, then refresh values).

steps.title: Start perfusion run
steps.instruction: Click “Run All” on the right side of the screen and turn on the peristaltic pump for outflow. Ensure the outflow needle is positioned high enough so the well does not dry out during long experiments.

steps.title: Control program execution
steps.instruction: To pause the program, click “Stop/Pause” once; to resume, click “Start”. To restart, click “Stop/Pause” twice and verify that the “Amount Dispensed” column resets to 0.
